title: Installed-Equipment Sales Tax Exclusion from Optional Coverage Add-Ons Cash Settlements
content:
**Tax schedule extract.** The cash value of a cash settlement under the Optional Coverage Add-Ons excludes the installed-equipment sales tax rate in Bridgewell's tax schedule for the region where the base homeowner property lies, which Bridgewell does not incur when it pays cash. The region is read from the property ZIP code recorded on the base Homeowner Service Contracts contract.

| Property ZIP code | Region | The cash basis, after the rates applied to it, is divided by |
|---|---|---|
| 75000 through 79999 | Texas | One plus 0.0825 (8.25 percent) |
| 43000 through 45999 | Ohio | One plus 0.0575 (5.75 percent) |
| Any other ZIP code | | One |

The division is made before the figure is rounded to the cent.

**Hypothetical figures.** A cash basis of USD 1,082.50 with a cash rate of one: in ZIP code 77002 it becomes 1,082.50 divided by 1.0825, which is USD 1,000.00; in ZIP code 44114 it becomes 1,082.50 divided by 1.0575, about USD 1,023.64; in ZIP code 30301 it stays USD 1,082.50.
